pages.title: Role in Progression
pages.text: Core Formation techniques enter the realm of divine arts: advanced Qingyuan Sword Art swordplay, Five-Element escape arts, illusions, demon-beast talents, ghost-path secrets, demonic forbidden arts, and orthodox true flames. These currently serve as rules data for later integration with method learning, sect inheritance, and high-level combat.

pages.title: Qingyuan Sword Art
pages.text: Azure Origin Sword Radiance is the basic divine art for layers 1-3; Protective Sword Shield covers layers 4-6 with both offense and defense; Sword-Shadow Light-Splitting Art creates multiple blade images at layers 7-9; and the Great Geng Sword Formation is the ultimate formation for layers 10-13. The second dispersal of the Threefold Essence-Reforming Art further compresses true essence.

pages.title: Escape Arts and Illusions
pages.text: Wood, Thunder, and Metal Escape depend respectively on vegetation, lightning, and metal-rich terrain. Blood-Shadow Escape and Nine Gale Transformations favor avian demon cultivators. The Phantom Spirit Art and Great Luo Thousand Illusions Art are Thousand Illusions Sect divine arts for deception, concealment, and infiltration.

pages.title: Orthodox and Women's Inheritances
pages.text: The Core Formation chapter of the Pure Maiden Reincarnation Art, the Maiden's Heavenly Moon Art, and Reincarnation Divine Light emphasize moonlight, preserved youth, control, and the soul. Violet Net Supreme Flame and Jade Yang True Flame are advanced fire divine arts; Jade Yang True Flame is especially effective against yin-aligned ghosts and corruption.

pages.title: Demonic, Ghost, and Beast Paths
pages.text: The Sky-Bearing Demon Art and Blood-Net Barrier favor defense, while the Kui-Water Demon Art, Blood Spirit Grand Art, and Yin-Demon Slash emphasize demonic offense. Profound Soul Ghostfire and Profound Soul Bone-Condensing Art belong to the ghost path. Celestial Fox Bewitching Art and Heavenly Wolf Drill are demon-beast talents. Inverted Phoenix Essence-Nurturing Art and Dragon-Enticing Art are cruel forbidden arts that should carry severe karmic and mechanical consequences.
